name: Initialize project structure
done_when: cd frontend && npm run dev shows Astro running; cd backend && go build ./cmd/server succeeds

name: Implement whisper.cpp integration
done_when: cd backend && go test ./internal/transcribe/... passes with whisper.cpp transcription test

name: Basic file upload UI
done_when: Open localhost:3000, select a file, submit form; browser network tab shows multipart POST to backend

name: Database setup
done_when: cd backend && go run ./cmd/migrate creates subtitler.db with users and jobs tables

name: Email and password authentication
done_when: curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/register -d '{"email":"test@test.com","password":"pass"}' returns 200; subsequent login returns session token

name: User dashboard
done_when: Login as user, navigate to /dashboard, see list of past jobs with download links

name: Background job queue
done_when: Upload file, check /api/jobs shows pending status; wait for worker, status changes to complete

name: Multiple output formats
done_when: curl localhost:8080/api/transcribe?format=vtt returns VTT; format=embedded returns video file with subtitles

name: Job status and notifications
done_when: Upload file, dashboard shows progress updating; email received when job completes

name: CI/CD pipeline
done_when: git push to trunk triggers GitHub webhook; new version deploys automatically

name: Secrets management
done_when: sops -d secrets.enc.yaml outputs decrypted secrets; deployment uses decrypted values

name: Create MARKETING_PLAN.md
done_when: cat MARKETING_PLAN.md shows content creator outreach strategy with target platforms

name: Create EXPERIMENTATION_PLAN.md
done_when: cat EXPERIMENTATION_PLAN.md shows A/B testing framework with metrics for success

name: Analytics integration
done_when: Upload and download file; analytics endpoint or dashboard shows corresponding events
